summary: The stderr return value holds error output from command-line utilities run by modules like command, shell and raw.
questions: Where is the error output of a command task?

answer_card.title: stderr return value
answer_card.answer_md: **`stderr`** contains the error output of the executed utility, e.g. `"ls: foo: No such file or directory"`. Set by modules that run commands (`command`, `shell`, `raw`, etc.).
